parts.label: Part 1
parts.article:
Part one.

You will hear a woman talking to a member of staff at a gym about joining the gym.

First, you have some time to look at questions one to four.

Now listen carefully and answer questions one to four.

Good morning. Can I help you?

Yes, actually. I'm interested in joining your gym, so I thought I'd come and find out about your membership options.

Why don't you take a seat, and I'll just get the form and a pen.

Thanks.

Now, your full name, please.

It's Jean Simpson.

Right. Jean... Is that Simpson with a P?

Yeah.

Right, Jean. Date of birth?

The twenty-fourth of August, nineteen seventy-nine.

And where do you live?

Seventy Fox Lane.

Is that fox as in the animal?

Yes, and it's Surfers Paradise four one six seven.

Do you have a home phone number, Jean?

Yes, it's double three seven eight four one five O.

Great. Now that we have that information, I'll tell you about the membership plans we offer, and you can select a payment option that suits you.

That sounds good.

Our two most popular payment options are yearly and monthly. The yearly membership fee works out as being about eleven dollars per week. On the monthly plan, you pay slightly more each week. By the way, this month, with both of these options, we're offering a free gym outfit.

That's great. I think I'll go for the yearly option. The initial outlay is more, but I'm mostly interested in getting in shape, and that option will help keep me coming. Even if I don't like it, I should be fit by the end.

Fair enough. The yearly option it is then. Have you got any questions or concerns?

Yeah. I'm going away for a month, and I won't be able to come to the gym during that time.

Hmm. Lots of people have this problem when they go on holiday. We can just suspend your gym membership for that month.

That's a relief. It won't be until July, and it's for work, actually. But next year, I'm going overseas to my friend's wedding, so can I suspend my membership for a couple of weeks then as well?

No problem. Just tell us about that closer to the date of your departure.

Before you hear the rest of the conversation, you have some time to look at questions five to ten.

Now listen and answer questions five to ten.

I'll tell you about the facilities we offer here. We offer a range of group fitness classes such as body step, body tone, and body balance.

They all sound very interesting, but I can't see myself ever going to a class.

Well, if that's not an option, perhaps you should try some general weight training exercises in the gym. Our instructors are fully trained and very good at helping new members to feel comfortable. Everybody's encouraged to go at their own pace.

I like the sound of that. I wouldn't have to get fit first, would I? I could just start straight away?

That's right. Let me tell you about the other services we offer. Are you interested in doing any water-based training?

Mm.

Well, we have an Olympic-sized swimming pool where you can do aqua aerobics classes. That's group exercise in the swimming pool. Or we can develop a personal swimming plan to suit your needs.

Aqua aerobics doesn't really appeal to me. I'm really not very keen on fixed classes, but working on my own swimming regime would be okay in a few months when I'm a bit fitter, I suppose.

Fine. We also have a sauna where you can relax after a strong workout.

[chuckles] That's not my idea of relaxing. Saunas are just too hot for me.

[chuckles] Many people feel that way, I must say. One other facility we offer is our child-minding service. It's available to our members at five dollars per child.

Well, my husband will be working at home for the first few months, so he'll be able to look after the baby when I'm exercising. But once he goes back to work, I'll probably be using that service.

Right. If you don't have any questions, let's finalize things. We can arrange payment and make an entry key for you to use whenever you come to the gym.

That is the end of part one.

You now have forty-five seconds to check your answers to part one.

Personal Details

analyses.content: 录音中男士询问出生日期，女士明确回答是8月24日（The twenty-fourth of August）。
Date of birth? The twenty-fourth of August, nineteen seventy-nine.
你可能会把年份（1979）也顺手写上，但注意题目字数限制是“ONE WORD ONLY AND/OR A NUMBER”，填 24th August 或 August 24th 最稳妥且刚好符合要求。
Seventy Fox Lane. Is that fox as in the animal? Yes.
这个词拼写很简单，但你写的时候可能会犹豫，录音紧接着专门向女士确认了“是不是动物里的那个fox”，帮你彻底打消了拼写疑虑。
录音中女士回答住址是 Seventy Fox Lane，男士随后确认了这里的 fox 就是指动物“狐狸”。

questions.question: What is Jean's reason for choosing the yearly payment option?

analyses.content: I think I'll go for the yearly option. The initial outlay is more, but I'm mostly interested in getting in shape, and that option will help keep me coming.
你可能听到男士说“免费送运动服”就选了B，但那是所有会员卡都送的福利；也可能想选A（省钱），但女士自己承认初期花费其实更多，她纯粹是为了锻炼身体。
女士明确表示选择年卡是因为主要想塑形（getting in shape，同义替换 become fitter），年卡能督促自己坚持去。

questions.question: What is Jean doing in July this year?

analyses.content: That's a relief. It won't be until July, and it's for work, actually. But next year, I'm going overseas to my friend's wedding, so can I suspend my membership for a couple of weeks then as well?
你可能听到男士之前瞎猜的 holiday（选项A），或者女士后面提到的明年去参加 wedding（选项C）就急着选了，这里必须严格对应题目中的时间限定词“今年7月（July this year）”。
女士明确说7月份离开健身房实际上是因为工作（it's for work，同义替换 travelling for business）。

analyses.content: We offer a range of group fitness classes such as body step, body tone, and body balance. They all sound very interesting, but I can't see myself ever going to a class.
听到前半句的“sound very interesting”你可能以为她现在感兴趣，千万别忽略了紧跟在后面的转折词“but”以及她否定的真实意愿。
女士表示虽然听起来有趣，但自己完全无法想象去上团操课（can't see myself ever going to a class），对应完全不感兴趣（C）。
男士推荐普通力量训练后，女士表示听起来不错，并反复确认自己是不是“可以直接开始”（start straight away），对应现在感兴趣（B）。

Well, if that's not an option, perhaps you should try some general weight training exercises in the gym... I like the sound of that. I wouldn't have to get fit first, would I? I could just start straight away?
你可能没听懂“start straight away”代表她此时此刻想立刻参与的强烈意愿，导致不敢选B。
Well, we have an Olympic-sized swimming pool where you can do aqua aerobics classes. That's group exercise in the swimming pool... Aqua aerobics doesn't really appeal to me.
录音里的 aqua aerobics classes（水上健美操）就是题目中的 group fitness in the pool 的同义替换，没反应过来就容易找错定位词。
女士明确表示水上健美操对她并没有什么吸引力（doesn't really appeal to me），对应完全不感兴趣（C）。
I'm really not very keen on fixed classes, but working on my own swimming regime would be okay in a few months when I'm a bit fitter, I suppose.
你可能会把前一题她对“水上健美操团课”的排斥态度，错误地平移到“个人游泳训练（my own swimming regime）”上从而错选C，要分清这俩是不同的项目。
女士说自己练游泳可以在“几个月后”自己稍微变健康一点时进行（in a few months），对应未来可能感兴趣（A）。
We also have a sauna where you can relax after a strong workout. [chuckles] That's not my idea of relaxing. Saunas are just too hot for me.
听到男士在推销时说的“relax”你可能就匆忙下结论选了B，做配对题一定得听完对话另一方（本题主角女士）的真实反馈。
女士笑着反驳说桑拿根本不能让她放松，对她来说太热了（just too hot for me），对应完全不感兴趣（C）。
Well, my husband will be working at home for the first few months, so he'll be able to look after the baby when I'm exercising. But once he goes back to work, I'll probably be using that service.
听到“丈夫现在能照顾孩子”，你可能以为她完全不需要而秒选了C，漏听了转折词“But”后面补充说明的未来情况。
女士说头几个月丈夫在家带孩子，但等他恢复上班后（once he goes back to work），自己很可能就会用这个服务了，对应未来可能感兴趣（A）。
